name: vantrecomb-procurement-plugin
description: Buyer-controlled Vantrecomb procurement through the existing B2B server's MCP and OAuth integration.

defaultPrompt: Help me source a custom comb project through VANTRE.
Check my authorized quotation and shipment status.
interface.longDescription: Discover structured product facts, prepare buyer-approved RFQs, and access your authorized quotes, orders, shipments and documents. Account access uses Vantrecomb OAuth with least-privilege scopes. The MCP integration uses the existing Vantrecomb B2B backend architecture; available operations follow the connected account's scopes and permissions.
